title: Example: a deep, wide field
summary: An example setting of the idea graph generator, not a real field: 80 ideas in 8 levels, about two parents each, four bounties at the top.

title: Example: narrow stages (drug discovery story)
summary: An example setting of the idea graph generator, told as drug discovery but not measured from it: six stages, each reusing only part of the evidence before it; three bounties.

title: Example: small and tightly linked (battery story)
summary: An example setting of the idea graph generator, told as a battery but not measured from it: 20 ideas, each leaning heavily on several earlier ones; two bounties.
